description: Canonical fill of the participant diagnostic document. Post-July-2013 discharge, deferred judgment never revoked, participant believes every financial obligation is paid, case no longer on the public docket. Every value is obviously synthetic. Docket/case number, OTN, judge, judge address, county attorney position, and all protected and outside-party fields stay blank.

screeningData.wasDeferredJudgment: Yes — deferred judgment, not a conviction and not a dismissal
screeningData.financialObligationsPaid: Yes — participant states everything in that case is paid
screeningData.stillOnPublicDocket: No — the case no longer appears

partyData.petitionerAddress: 123 Sample Street, Apt 4, Sample City, IA 50000

chargeData.chargeDescription: Court record with reference to the deferred judgment in the case named above
chargeData.disposition: Deferred judgment under Iowa Code § 907.3, discharged from probation
chargeData.relatedDismissedCounts: Dismissed counts in the same charging instrument, and other related dismissed charges arising from the same transaction or occurrence or a common scheme or plan

eligibilityData.eligibilityBasisLabel: Expungement of the court record with reference to a deferred judgment on discharge from probation, Iowa Code § 907.9(4)
eligibilityData.waitingPeriodText: Discharge from probation, with all financial obligations in that case paid — duration: none beyond discharge and payment
eligibilityData.reliefFraming: The court record becomes confidential and comes off public access under Iowa Code § 22.7. It is not accessible except by court order.
additionalFacts: There is no participant filing on this branch. The expungement is expected to occur on discharge without an application.
This mechanism sits outside Iowa R. Crim. P. 2.80 through 2.86 and has no Rule 2.86 form.
The deferred judgment itself remains on the state court administrator's deferred judgment docket and is not expunged.
The record is not expunged until restitution, civil penalties, court costs, fees and other obligations in the case containing the deferred judgment are paid.
The participant obtains the clerk's confirmation of the balance in that case. LegalEase does not obtain, receive or inspect it.
